## Selling what you make — commercial license membership

An active subscription grants you a **non-exclusive license to manufacture and sell

generate with this tool — for the duration of your subscription period. An active
subscription is required to commercially manufacture, advertise, and sell physical prints

It is **$15/month** (or $40/quarter, $150/year), and it covers the entire catalog.

Get the commercial license here:
**https://makerworld.com/en/@Vostok_Labs#commercial-membership-open**

### What you can do

- Sell unlimited physical 3D prints of licensed models.

- Print in any size, material, color, or print settings.
- Use the official product photos, renders, and marketing images in your listings.
- Use the official product descriptions as a starting point, or adapt them to your needs.
- Make minor functional modifications for printing or customer-specific customization, provided they do not create a new digital product for distribution or sale.

### Restrictions

- You may not share, redistribute, sell, or upload the digital model files, or any modified versions of them.

- You may not create molds, castings, injection-molded products, or other forms of mass production without prior written permission.
- You may not use the designs in crowdfunding campaigns — Kickstarter or any other — without prior written permission.
